objective: minimize squared reblur residual plus lambda times squared distance to blurred input
selection: one lambda per severity, highest mean full-crop clipped PSNR on the 50 frozen DIV2K development images, exact tie favors larger lambda
reference: original SHA256, source dimensions, crop and 512-pixel RGB LANCZOS as archived; verify decoded pixels against all 20 retained development previews and input score parity on all evaluation images
boundary: exact separable reflection, without repeating the edge pixel, radius ceil(3*sigma)
scoring: RGB float32 clipped to [0,1]; full crop for all four metrics; report border and interior MSE separately
privileged_information: true Gaussian kernel and severity; no test reference is used by the inverse
